description: A shell script containing test cases for git diff functionality, including comparisons of blobs, trees, paths, and modes, utilizing git commands and assertions.

methods.name: run_diff
methods.description: Runs 'git diff' with specified arguments, outputs to a file named 'diff'.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks if the diff contains the expected index line matching provided SHA1s.

methods.name: check_mode
methods.description: Checks if the diff contains mode change lines matching expected modes.

methods.name: check_paths
methods.description: Verifies that the diff references specified file paths.
